when_used: Only when the card's video model (price menu, F14 lock) is a Kling video model instead of MiniMax H3. Never for lip-sync (that is kling/ai-avatar-standard, models/kling-ai-avatar-standard.json).
section_order: Same order as minimax-h3.json, compressed: header, subject, action, reference, camera, lens_light, continuity, look, book, pages, physics, beats, policy, negatives.
differences_from_h3: No bracket camera syntax: Kling takes the move in plain words, placed AFTER the subject's motion (file 17: 'Add camera movement after subject movement').
Look block uses the mode's kling_block (short form, about 350-450 characters), not the h3_block.
Negatives stay inside the prompt: the 67 catalog shows no negative_prompt control field for these KIE entries. Use a separate negative_prompt field only if a later catalog row lists it.
Band: 1,800-2,500 target (Kling recommends 2,500 or less); hard max from the catalog (3,072 omni, 2,500 for 3.0/video and 2.5 turbo).
Duration: kling-3.0-omni 3-15 s; 2.5 turbo 5 or 10 s only.
